author: Para_Dice
body:
Hello people of avicus!

Today I bring you a map. Inspiration from Super Mario Galaxy.


Max players: 20v20

Monuments: 2

Spawn Kit: (1) Stone Sword, (1) [Infinity] Bow, (1) Diamond Pickaxe, (64) Sandstone, (3) Gold Apple, (64) Cooked Fish, (64) Jungle Wood Log, (64) Endstone, (1) Iron Shovel. Inventory: (1) Leather Cap [Armor], (1) Leather Tunic [Armor], (64) Arrow.


Teams: Red VS Blue



Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/rat038mpx9s9bg3/Thunder8.rar


XML: Pending...


Images: I don't have images but I do have a video with the images in it. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z2z7TLQb1ZU


Have a nice day!

P.S: When the XML is made players will not be able to build in the sideline void!

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Hey nice map. I just have a few criticisms with it right now.

-Remove the lava.
          -Lava can be used with the buckets and can make for very uneven game play.
-Shorten the gap.
          -It would make for better game play with less bridging.
-Remove enchanting
          -I haven't seen a map that uses enchanting well and I do not believe Avicus is ready for it.
